text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia's foreign minister attacks attempts to impede an "oil-for-food" deal signed by Iraq and the U.N. on May 20.
- United Nations Development Programme says humanitarian situation deteriorating in Iraq.
- President Saddam Hussein meets with a Yemeni national.
(The above stories were also carried by IRAQ and THAWRA)
- Iraq's Vice-President Taha Yassin Ramadan warns against the misuse of irrigational dams in northern Iraq.
- Egyptian companies to hold on Saturday an exhibition of foodstuffs in Baghdad.
